name: ClickFunnels
description:
Connect Claude to your ClickFunnels account to work with your business data conversationally. Ask Claude to look up contacts, review store orders, check funnel performance, update course content, manage form submissions, draft email campaigns, and more — across every major area of ClickFunnels, including funnels, contacts, courses, emails, store, forms, blogs, sites, and workflows.

The connector uses a discovery-based design: Claude first explores what's available in a category, then reads, creates, or updates records on your behalf. Every write action is performed through the ClickFunnels V2 API with your permissions.

Access and security: When connecting, you choose exactly which workspaces Claude can access and grant per-category read/write permissions. Access is scoped to those grants on every request — Claude can never reach workspaces you didn't authorize. Connections are made via OAuth; no passwords or API keys are shared with Claude.

Requirements: A ClickFunnels account with team admin access is required to connect.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ClickFunnels to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ClickFunnels to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://agents.myclickfunnels.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ClickFunnels MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ClickFunnels provides these MCP tools: create, current_workspace, describe_category, destroy, fetch, list, list_workspaces, read_action, switch_workspace, take_action, and update.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ClickFunnels?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ClickFunnels in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
ClickFunnels requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ClickFunnels is developed by ClickFunnels. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
